checks.title: Ensure that the API server pod specification file permissions are set to 600 or more restrictive (Automated)
Ensure that the API server pod specification file ownership is set to root:root (Automated)
Ensure that the controller manager pod specification file permissions are set to 600 or more restrictive (Automated)
Ensure that the controller manager pod specification file ownership is set to root:root (Automated)
Ensure that the scheduler pod specification file permissions are set to 600 or more restrictive (Automated)
Ensure that the scheduler pod specification file ownership is set to root:root (Automated)
Ensure that the etcd pod specification file permissions are set to 600 or more restrictive (Automated)
Ensure that the etcd pod specification file ownership is set to root:root (Automated)
Ensure that the etcd data directory permissions are set to 700 or more restrictive (Automated)
checks.remediation: chmod 700 on the directory etcd's --data-dir names (kubeadm: /var/lib/etcd)

checks.title: Ensure that the etcd data directory ownership is set to etcd:etcd (Automated)
checks.remediation: useradd -r -s /usr/sbin/nologin etcd, then chown -R etcd:etcd on etcd's --data-dir

checks.title: Ensure that the default administrative credential file permissions are set to 600 (Automated)
Ensure that the default administrative credential file ownership is set to root:root (Automated)
Ensure that the scheduler.conf file permissions are set to 600 or more restrictive (Automated)
Ensure that the scheduler.conf file ownership is set to root:root (Automated)
Ensure that the controller-manager.conf file permissions are set to 600 or more restrictive (Automated)
Ensure that the controller-manager.conf file ownership is set to root:root (Automated)
Ensure that the Kubernetes PKI directory and file ownership is set to root:root (Automated)
Ensure that the Kubernetes PKI certificate file permissions are set to 644 or more restrictive (Manual)
Ensure that the Kubernetes PKI key file permissions are set to 600 (Manual)
Ensure that the --anonymous-auth argument is set to false (Manual)
checks.remediation: Set --anonymous-auth=false in /etc/kubernetes/manifests/kube-apiserver.yaml (health checks that rely on anonymous /livez and /readyz then need credentials)

checks.title: Ensure that the --token-auth-file parameter is not set (Automated)
checks.remediation: Remove --token-auth-file from /etc/kubernetes/manifests/kube-apiserver.yaml; use client certificates, OIDC or webhook authentication

checks.title: Ensure that the --DenyServiceExternalIPs is set (Manual)
Ensure that the --kubelet-client-certificate and --kubelet-client-key arguments are set as appropriate (Automated)
Ensure that the --kubelet-certificate-authority argument is set as appropriate (Automated)
checks.remediation: Give kubelets serving certificates signed by the cluster CA (serverTLSBootstrap: true and approve the CSRs), then set --kubelet-certificate-authority in /etc/kubernetes/manifests/kube-apiserver.yaml

checks.title: Ensure that the --authorization-mode argument is not set to AlwaysAllow (Automated)
Ensure that the --authorization-mode argument includes Node (Automated)
Ensure that the --authorization-mode argument includes RBAC (Automated)
Ensure that the admission control plugin EventRateLimit is set (Manual)
checks.remediation: Add EventRateLimit to --enable-admission-plugins and point --admission-control-config-file at its limits in /etc/kubernetes/manifests/kube-apiserver.yaml

checks.title: Ensure that the admission control plugin AlwaysAdmit is not set (Automated)
Ensure that the admission control plugin AlwaysPullImages is set (Manual)
checks.remediation: Add AlwaysPullImages to --enable-admission-plugins in /etc/kubernetes/manifests/kube-apiserver.yaml (it costs a registry round trip per pod start)

checks.title: Ensure that the admission control plugin ServiceAccount is set (Automated)
Ensure that the admission control plugin NamespaceLifecycle is set (Automated)
Ensure that the admission control plugin NodeRestriction is set (Automated)
Ensure that the --profiling argument is set to false (Automated)
Ensure that the --audit-log-path argument is set (Automated)
checks.remediation: Set --audit-log-path=/var/log/kubernetes/audit/audit.log and --audit-policy-file in /etc/kubernetes/manifests/kube-apiserver.yaml, with hostPath volumes for both

checks.title: Ensure that the --audit-log-maxage argument is set to 30 or as appropriate (Automated)
Ensure that the --audit-log-maxbackup argument is set to 10 or as appropriate (Automated)
Ensure that the --audit-log-maxsize argument is set to 100 or as appropriate (Automated)
Ensure that the --request-timeout argument is set as appropriate (Manual)

audit.manual: check that --request-timeout (default 60s) fits the longest legitimate request; raise it only for a reason you can name

checks.title: Ensure that the --service-account-lookup argument is set to true (Automated)
Ensure that the --service-account-key-file argument is set as appropriate (Automated)
checks.remediation: Set --service-account-key-file to the public key that verifies service account tokens in /etc/kubernetes/manifests/kube-apiserver.yaml

checks.title: Ensure that the --etcd-certfile and --etcd-keyfile arguments are set as appropriate (Automated)
Ensure that the --tls-cert-file and --tls-private-key-file arguments are set as appropriate (Automated)
Ensure that the --client-ca-file argument is set as appropriate (Automated)
Ensure that the --etcd-cafile argument is set as appropriate (Automated)
Ensure that the --encryption-provider-config argument is set as appropriate (Manual)
checks.remediation: Write an EncryptionConfiguration (aescbc, secretbox or kms) and set --encryption-provider-config in /etc/kubernetes/manifests/kube-apiserver.yaml, then rewrite existing Secrets

checks.title: Ensure that the API Server only makes use of Strong Cryptographic Ciphers (Manual)
checks.remediation: Set --tls-cipher-suites to a subset of the strong suites in /etc/kubernetes/manifests/kube-apiserver.yaml

checks.title: Ensure that the --service-account-extend-token-expiration parameter is set to false (Automated)
Ensure that the --terminated-pod-gc-threshold argument is set as appropriate (Manual)
Ensure that the --profiling argument is set to false (Automated)
Ensure that the --use-service-account-credentials argument is set to true (Automated)
Ensure that the --service-account-private-key-file argument is set as appropriate (Automated)
Ensure that the --root-ca-file argument is set as appropriate (Automated)
Ensure that the RotateKubeletServerCertificate argument is set to true (Automated)
Ensure that the --bind-address argument is set to 127.0.0.1 (Automated)
Ensure that the --profiling argument is set to false (Automated)
Ensure that the --bind-address argument is set to 127.0.0.1 (Automated)
Ensure that the --cert-file and --key-file arguments are set as appropriate (Automated)
Ensure that the --client-cert-auth argument is set to true (Automated)
Ensure that the --auto-tls argument is not set to true (Automated)
checks.remediation: Remove --auto-tls or set it to false in /etc/kubernetes/manifests/etcd.yaml

checks.title: Ensure that the --peer-cert-file and --peer-key-file arguments are set as appropriate (Automated)
Ensure that the --peer-client-cert-auth argument is set to true (Automated)
Ensure that the --peer-auto-tls argument is not set to true (Automated)
checks.remediation: Remove --peer-auto-tls or set it to false in /etc/kubernetes/manifests/etcd.yaml

checks.title: Ensure that a unique Certificate Authority is used for etcd (Manual)
checks.remediation: Issue etcd's certificates from a dedicated CA and set --trusted-ca-file to it in /etc/kubernetes/manifests/etcd.yaml

checks.title: Client certificate authentication should not be used for users (Manual)

audit.manual: find humans who authenticate with client certificates (issued CSRs, kubeconfigs handed out from admin.conf); certificates cannot be revoked

checks.remediation: Move people to OIDC or another revocable authenticator

checks.title: Service account token authentication should not be used for users (Manual)

audit.manual: find people using service account tokens as personal credentials (long-lived Secret tokens, tokens copied into kubeconfigs)

checks.remediation: Move people to OIDC; keep service account tokens for workloads

checks.title: Bootstrap token authentication should not be used for users (Manual)

audit.manual: find people using bootstrap tokens (kubectl -n kube-system get secrets --field-selector type=bootstrap.kubernetes.io/token)

checks.remediation: Delete bootstrap tokens once nodes have joined

checks.title: Ensure that a minimal audit policy is created (Manual)
checks.remediation: Write an audit Policy and set --audit-policy-file in /etc/kubernetes/manifests/kube-apiserver.yaml

checks.title: Ensure that the audit policy covers key security concerns (Manual)

audit.manual: read the audit policy: Metadata for Secrets, ConfigMaps and TokenReviews, and records of pods/exec, pods/portforward, pods/proxy and services/proxy

checks.remediation: Extend the audit policy to cover those requests

checks.title: Ensure that the kubelet service file permissions are set to 600 or more restrictive (Automated)
checks.remediation: chmod 600 on the kubelet unit file or drop-in that starts the kubelet (kubeadm: /etc/systemd/system/kubelet.service.d/10-kubeadm.conf)

checks.title: Ensure that the kubelet service file ownership is set to root:root (Automated)
checks.remediation: chown root:root on the kubelet unit file or drop-in

checks.title: Ensure that the --kubeconfig kubelet.conf file permissions are set to 600 or more restrictive (Automated)
checks.remediation: chmod 600 on the file the kubelet's --kubeconfig names (kubeadm: /etc/kubernetes/kubelet.conf)

checks.title: Ensure that the --kubeconfig kubelet.conf file ownership is set to root:root (Automated)
checks.remediation: chown root:root on the kubelet's --kubeconfig file

checks.title: Ensure that the certificate authorities file permissions are set to 644 or more restrictive (Manual)
checks.remediation: chmod 644 on the kubelet's client CA file

checks.title: Ensure that the client certificate authorities file ownership is set to root:root (Manual)
checks.remediation: chown root:root on the kubelet's client CA file

checks.title: If the kubelet config.yaml configuration file is being used validate permissions set to 600 or more restrictive (Automated)
checks.remediation: chmod 600 on the file the kubelet's --config names (kubeadm: /var/lib/kubelet/config.yaml)

checks.title: If the kubelet config.yaml configuration file is being used validate file ownership is set to root:root (Automated)
checks.remediation: chown root:root on the kubelet config file

checks.title: Ensure that the --anonymous-auth argument is set to false (Automated)
checks.remediation: Set authentication.anonymous.enabled: false in the kubelet config file, then systemctl restart kubelet; remove any --anonymous-auth=true flag

checks.title: Ensure that the --authorization-mode argument is not set to AlwaysAllow (Automated)
checks.remediation: Set authorization.mode: Webhook in the kubelet config file, then systemctl restart kubelet

checks.title: Ensure that the --client-ca-file argument is set as appropriate (Automated)
checks.remediation: Set authentication.x509.clientCAFile to the cluster CA in the kubelet config file, then systemctl restart kubelet

checks.title: Verify that if defined, the --read-only-port argument is set to 0 (Manual)
checks.remediation: Set readOnlyPort: 0 in the kubelet config file, then systemctl restart kubelet; remove any --read-only-port flag

checks.title: Ensure that the --streaming-connection-idle-timeout argument is not set to 0 (Manual)
checks.remediation: Set streamingConnectionIdleTimeout to a duration such as 5m in the kubelet config file, then systemctl restart kubelet; remove --streaming-connection-idle-timeout=0

checks.title: Ensure that the --make-iptables-util-chains argument is set to true (Automated)
checks.remediation: Remove makeIPTablesUtilChains: false and --make-iptables-util-chains=false, then restart the kubelet

checks.title: Ensure that the --hostname-override argument is not set (Manual)
checks.remediation: Remove --hostname-override from the kubelet's flags (kubeadm-flags.env or the unit file); some cloud providers require it, which is why this check is manual

checks.title: Ensure that the --tls-cert-file and --tls-private-key-file arguments are set as appropriate (Manual)
checks.remediation: Set tlsCertFile and tlsPrivateKeyFile, or use serverTLSBootstrap: true so the kubelet requests a CA-signed serving certificate

checks.title: Ensure that the --rotate-certificates argument is not set to false (Automated)
checks.remediation: Set rotateCertificates: true or remove it in the kubelet config file, then systemctl restart kubelet

checks.title: Verify that the RotateKubeletServerCertificate argument is set to true (Manual)
checks.remediation: Remove RotateKubeletServerCertificate=false from the kubelet's feature gates

checks.title: Ensure that the Kubelet only makes use of Strong Cryptographic Ciphers (Manual)
checks.remediation: Set tlsCipherSuites to a subset of the strong suites in the kubelet config file, then systemctl restart kubelet

checks.title: Ensure that a limit is set on pod PIDs (Manual)
checks.remediation: Set podPidsLimit (for example 4096) in the kubelet config file, then systemctl restart kubelet

checks.title: Ensure that the --seccomp-default parameter is set to true (Manual)
checks.remediation: Set seccompDefault: true in the kubelet config file, then systemctl restart kubelet; test workloads first, RuntimeDefault blocks some syscalls

checks.title: Ensure that the --protect-kernel-defaults argument is set to true (Automated)
checks.remediation: Set protectKernelDefaults: true after the node's sysctls match what the kubelet expects (vm.overcommit_memory=1, kernel.panic=10, kernel.panic_on_oops=1), or the kubelet refuses to start
checks.note: 4.2.6 in CIS Kubernetes V1.24 Benchmark v1.0.0 and earlier; not in v1.7.0 or later, where 4.2.6 is --make-iptables-util-chains
